text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see... El was talking in her<n>sleep last
night, and I couldn't help<n>but be a little curious...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
She must've been having the buffet<n>of her dreams,
because she kept<n>calling out things like "a la
plancha"<n>and "gazpacho."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It's incredible how she can muster<n>that much
energy even while<n>sleeping...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: So you see, I didn't catch a wink allnight... Yawn...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: It seems Grass Wonder needs more<n>sleep.
